title: ApertureConfig
description: Configuration schema for aperture.config.json, the config file written by `aperture init` and read by all Aperture commands.

budgetTokens.description: Estimated token budget for total ambient context. Used by reporters to flag when the scanned total exceeds this threshold.

ignore.description: Glob patterns for files or directories to exclude from scanning across all built-in ContextSources.

claudeMdWarnBytes.description: Byte size threshold above which a CLAUDE.md file triggers an `aperture doctor` warning for being oversized.

estimator.description: Identifier for the token estimation strategy to use. v1 ships one heuristic estimator; this field exists so alternative estimators can be introduced without changing the config shape.

plugins.description: npm package names or local file paths to third-party ContextSource plugins, loaded dynamically at scan time. A plugin that fails to load is skipped with a warning rather than aborting the scan.
